node.title: PMA rate-half source-aligned gcd excess
node.statement: For fixed core and three touched petals, the forced PMA core word belongs to an explicit three-dimensional CRT quotient code: if E_c is constant c_i modulo each petal locator, then L_C E_c=P_*+LY and y=Y on the core. Any three tail contributors force the exact aligned overlap inequality u_12+u_13+u_23-tau >= 2(K_0-1)+3a, where the four terms are degrees of gcds with L_C, the source numerator P_*, and the three pair differences. Ambient equality fibers not carrying the source value are excluded. Absence of this certificate pays the tail by 8n per source.
